task: Draft a cookie notice for a fictional publishing website that uses only strictly necessary cookies. The notice must be accurate: there is no tracking or analytics to opt out of, so do not include an accept/reject choice for non-existent tracking.

facts.text: The website uses only strictly necessary cookies for session management and security.
The website does not use analytics, advertising, or preference cookies.
Users have no meaningful tracking choice to make on this site.
The notice serves a transparency purpose, not a consent purpose, because no tracking requires consent.
No third-party tracking scripts are used.

forbidden_additions: An accept or reject toggle for tracking that does not exist on this site.
A claim that strictly necessary cookies require user consent to operate.
preserve: Strictly necessary cookies only: session and security.
Transparency framing rather than consent collection.
